statement: Show that for any positive reals \(a, b, c\), \[(a+b)(a+c) \geq 2\sqrt{abc(a+b+c)}.\]

Given \(a_0 > 1\), the sequence \(a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots\) is such that for all \(k > 0\), \(a_k\) is the smallest integer greater than \(a_{k-1}\) that is relatively prime to all earlier terms. Find all \(a_0\) for which every term of the sequence is a prime or a prime power.

In triangle \(ABC\), points \(E\) and \(F\) lie on \(AB\) with \(AE = EF = FB\). Point \(D\) lies on line \(BC\) such that \(ED \perp BC\) and \(AD \perp CF\). Given that \(3\angle BDF = \angle CFA\), determine the ratio \(\dfrac{DB}{DC}\).
A calculator treats angles as radians and initially displays \(1\). What is the largest value that can be achieved by pressing the buttons \(\cos\) or \(\sin\) a total of \(2001\) times?

An altitude of a convex quadrilateral is a line through the midpoint of a side perpendicular to the opposite side. Show that the four altitudes are concurrent if and only if the quadrilateral is cyclic.

A one-player game is played as follows: there is a bowl at each integer on the \(x\)-axis. All bowls are initially empty except for the bowl at the origin, which contains \(n \geq 2\) stones. A move is either: (A) remove two stones from a bowl and place one in each of the two adjacent bowls; or (B) remove one stone from each of two adjacent bowls and add one stone to the bowl immediately to their left. Show that only a finite number of moves can be made and that the final position is independent of the moves made (for a given \(n\)).
